name: t23-g4-integrated-overload
description: T23 / G4 overload/burst case. Ten clients try to join a server capped at 8 live clients (server_max_clients=8): the two surplus joins must be refused explicitly ("server at capacity"), not hang or corrupt anything. Meanwhile the admitted eight drive 6x the spec edit rate (60 edits/s, one per tick, fresh comb-tooth geometry) and a 4 m tower blast every 2 s (5x), plus the giant collapse, with baselines paced at 1 MiB/s. Requirements: every scripted edit commits (no loss), all admitted replicas + replay + restart converge on one hash, no reliable-backlog overflow, the refusal counter equals the surplus joins, memory stays bounded.
